items.followUp: State two functions of the nucleus.

rubric.why: A digestive role of lysosomes is identified.
rubric.description: Lysosomes digest waste materials or foreign particles in the cell.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that lysosomes digest waste or foreign particles.

rubric.why: A second function of lysosomes is identified.
rubric.description: Lysosomes break down worn-out organelles and can bring about autolysis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for describing the breakdown of worn-out organelles or naming autolysis.

modelAnswer: Lysosomes digest waste materials and foreign particles in the cell.
They break down worn out organelles and can cause autolysis.
